metadata.title: Gaia DR3 wide binary star kinematics and the low-acceleration velocity plateau in Chronodynamic Relativity
metadata.description: Wide binary star systems with projected separations s > 2 to 5 kAU probe gravitational accelerations below the critical cosmic scale a_0 approx 1.635e-10 m/s^2. Evaluating over 26,000 high-purity wide binary pairs from Gaia DR3 under the non-linear algebraic root law g_eff = 0.5 * [g_N + sqrt(g_N^2 + 4 * g_N * a_0)] with Galactic background screening, the model predicts an asymptotic velocity boost gamma_v approx 1.14 to 1.18, exactly matching the empirical velocity plateau observed in Gaia DR3 with reduced chi^2/dof = 0.36.
